title: First step of the extractor
statement: Let $first,second$ be Boolean flags, let $x,pre,rest,a$ be Boolean words, and let $b$ be a bit, with $x=pre\mathbin{++}[b]\mathbin{++}rest$. One step of the pair extractor from its block-start configuration at input position $|pre|$, with buffer $a$, work head at $|a|$, and empty output, leaves the buffer, work head, and output unchanged, advances the input head to position $|pre|+1$, and enters the control state recording $b$.
hypotheses_covered: first and second are Boolean flags
x, pre, rest, and a are Boolean words
x=pre followed by b and rest
replaced:
If the input splits as $x = p\, b\, r$ with bit $b$, one step of the pair
extractor from its block-start state at position $\abs{p}$ records $b$ in the
finite control and advances the input head, leaving the buffer and the output
unchanged.
